name: *small is all* Application at South Shore

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 10 yrs but less than 16 yrs

description: * THIS IS A PROGRAM APPLICATION* - actual program runs from October 6 to November 17th every Tuesday 4:30-6:30pm! Please read full description for details. *small is all* is a 7- week nature-based art program for Chicago youth ages 10-15. This program supports young people in growing their love for earth and Land stewardship using a variety of art and creative practices. Throughout *small is all* we learn about local Environmental Justice issues, organizers, artists, scientists, and more. *small is all* invites young people to learn about the ancestral wisdom of nature, and investigate the local ecosystem and social relationships in the world around them through art. Each season we have 1 or 2 field trips outside of scheduled program dates (generally Saturdays). Throughout the season we explore planting and learning about seeds, making art using recycled materials, and visiting natural areas (such as farms, gardens or parks) in or near the Chicago area. This season we also hope to have special guests who are farmers, land stewards, local organizers, and more. In the past, art making has included learning how to quilt/sew, using clay, paper mache, bookbinding, and more. This fall *small is all* will meet weekly on Tuesdays from 4:30-6:30pm at South Shore Cultural Center for 7 weeks (Tuesday October 6th to Novmeber 17th). We will also be taking 2 field trips on Saturday (dates TBD). Youth who participate in at least 5 weeks of *small is all* will be paid a stipend of $300 at the end of the program. Applicants must live in the City of Chicago and be a US citizen between 10 and 15 years old. Please note: it is Chicago Park District policy that youth submit a W9 and create an iSupplier account in order to receive their stipend. This will be required to complete registration if admitted into the program. Ideal candidates are those who: - Are creative and/or have an interest in the arts - Enjoy being outdoors or are interested in exploring nature - Work well with others and in groups - Can commit to the *small is all* schedule Applying only expresses interest in the program and does not guarantee admission into the *small is all* program. If you/your child is accepted into *small is all*, a follow-up email will be sent within a week of the application closing date.

name: 2 Day: South Side Skating Academy at Morgan Park SC

description: The South Side Skating Academy is a Bridge Program, for skaters looking to Bridge the gap between recreational Learn to Skate, and starting to become a competitive skater. The Academy is for skaters in Pre-Free Skate through Free Skate 3, and is made up of multiple classes (on and off the ice) each week, for a reduced rate. Skaters in the Bridge Program will be enrolled in this structured training program, with the goal to join the MPSC Competitive Team. Cost (if registered for 2 more sessions) also includes a Membership Team Jacket, and other activities.

name: 2027 Herbie Hancock Fellows at Marquette

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Join the Marquette Park Cultural Center for a free concert! In fall 2025, six extraordinary young jazz musicians from around the world were selected for the Herbie Hancock Institute of Jazz Performance at UCLA, Class of 2027. These excellent players study deeply as individuals and as a small group—receiving personal mentoring, ensemble coaching, and lectures on the jazz tradition from the legends of the jazz tradition. Beyond that, they are charged to experiment in expanding jazz in new directions through their compositions and performances. Herbie Hancock Fellows have performed in Saint Petersburg, Russia; Havana, Cuba; Melbourne, Sydney and Mt. Gambier, Australia; at the celebration commemorating the 40th anniversary of the coronation of the King of Thailand, the 1998 Summit of the Americas in Chile before 34 heads of state, the United Nations “Day of Philosophy” event in Paris sponsored by UNESCO, and the Tokyo Jazz Festival. The students have also participated in tours of Argentina, China, Egypt, India, Morocco, Peru, Russia, Vietnam and, most recently, Jordan with Institute Chairman Herbie Hancock. These musicians’ concepts and playing will come to define the sound of jazz well into the future. Come get an early glimpse into what that jazz will sound like. The Hancock Fellows will come to the Marquette Park Cultural Center on April 28th at 4:30 for a free show in its historic auditorium. This unprecedented performance has come to the Southwest Side as a part of International Jazz Day celebrations, hosted this year by the City of Chicago. Free admission! Nicolaus Gelin: trumpet Nathan Gilbreath: trombone Mwanzi Harriott: guitar Yerin Kim: bass Elisee Ngbo: piano Mailo Rakotonanahary: drums

name: 312 Grit at Jefferson

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: 312 Grit is a functional fitness and personal development program designed for individuals who aspire to elevate their health, performance, and overall quality of life. The program integrates high-level functional training with education in proper nutrition and intentional character development, creating a well-rounded approach to long-term success. At its core, 312 Grit focuses on improving sports performance, strength, conditioning, mobility, and resilience through purposeful, scalable workouts. Beyond physical training, participants are guided in building sustainable nutrition habits that support performance, recovery, and lifelong wellness. What sets 312 Grit apart is its emphasis on developing the character traits of tomorrow’s leaders: discipline, accountability, grit, teamwork, and integrity. Through mentorship, structured competition, and shared challenges, athletes learn to push beyond comfort while supporting one another in a team-centered environment. 312 Grit is more than a workout class; it is a mentoring-driven community where individuals are challenged to grow physically, mentally, and emotionally. The program prepares participants not only to perform at a higher level in sport, but to lead with confidence, resilience, and purpose in every area of life.

name: AACM Future Explorations at Fred Anderson

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: This year the AACM would like to celebrate the future of our Great Black Music tradition, ancient to the future. We will feature compositions from three of our youngest members- Adam Zanolini, Alexis Lombre, and Angel Bat Dawid. Their development as musicians and composers has been nurtured by the inter-generational ensemble of the AACM's Great Black Music Ensemble. These three emerging composers draw upon traditional forms of African American music and music from the African diaspora. These musicians push boldly into radically unknown territory, creating future explorations of the outer realms. This event is presented as a part of the City of Chicago’s 2020 Year of Chicago Music. Experience music in the key of Chicago at www.YearofChicagoMusic.org .

name: About Face Theatre Pres. Life Out Loud at Gill

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Three friends journey through a gallery of stories from LGBTQ+ people, past and present. Together they investigate history’s torn out pages, discovering the power of authentic friendship, and new ideas to expand our understanding of gender and sexuality. This charming, funny, and interactive play uses poetry and improv to introduce gender expansive vocabulary, healthy coping mechanisms and often forgotten Black and Asian queer history. Starring Haven A.J. Crawley, Jett Pasia, and Ua Smith. Written by Dionne Addai, with the Life Out Loud Ensemble and Theatrical Consultation from Lexi Saunders including contributed pieces from Zahra Baker and Aimy Tien.

name: Adaptive Dance at McFetridge

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: This creative dance workshop invites students ages 6-10 with physical disabilities to explore the joy of movement in a welcoming, inclusive space designed just for them. Together, we'll discover essential movement concepts — like shape, space, level, and energy — through playful, age-appropriate improvisation and engaging dance activities. Every mover's body is celebrated as a source of creativity and expression. There's no "right way" to move here — just curiosity, exploration, and the confidence that grows when students feel seen and supported in expressing themselves authentically. Caregivers are welcome to stay and assist as needed, ensuring every student has the support they need to fully participate and shine. Come move, explore, and dance with us!

name: Adult Martial Arts & Self Defense at Morgan Park SC

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Our Martial Arts program will build on the skills that focuses on the self-defense and Kung Fu. The curriculum includes conflict resolution and non-lethal restraint. Skills include blocks, kicks, punches, falls and throws. All students receive a study sheet that will assist parents in reviewing the material. The class also works on flexibility, running, endurance, strength, concentration and coordination. Students will perform exercises such as jogging, jumping jacks, lunges, and push ups. All students will begin with a warmup; if student is tardy, they will still have a quick warmup to prepare their body for class activity. Participants are able to sign up for more than one class for additional practice and develop stronger technique

name: Adult Modern Partnership at Berger

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Kristina Fluty leads this modern dance class for advanced and professional dancers, hosted by Arts Partner Synapse Arts. Kristina has been teaching and dancing in Chicago for the past two decades. Her main creative home since 2003 is molly Shanahan/Mad Shak, and she is currently completing the inaugural Spiral Body Techniques teacher certification with Shanahan. She is an Associate Professor at The Theatre School at DePaul, where she teaches movement to actors. Her dance class prioritizes pleasure and honoring/embracing how you move right now. It is also anchored by Fluty's certification in Laban/Bartenieff Movement Analysis and her many years of Feldenkrais personal study. Class will likely begin on the floor with gentle developmental movement phases, then evolve out into dancing with delicious complexity, spatial clarity, and ease.

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Join us for an evening of recreation, wellness, and connection at our Adult Sports & Social Night! Whether you're looking to stay active, learn a new sport, or simply enjoy time with friends, this program offers something for everyone. Participants will rotate through a variety of activities, including ice skating, tennis, and pickleball, with opportunities for all skill levels to participate in a fun and welcoming environment. The evening also includes a wellness session focused on stretching, recovery, mindfulness, or healthy living to help promote overall well-being. Come meet new people, enjoy friendly competition, and experience a balanced night of fitness, fun, and community.

name: Adult Swimming and Sports (Special Rec) at Mt. Greenwood

age_range.raw_age_text: 16 yrs +

description: For individuals with a primary intellectual or developmental disability. Participants will learn basic swimming techniques, advanced breathing techniques, and mechanics of the four basic strokes (freestyle, backstroke, butterfly and breaststroke). Participants will be grouped according to skill level. Learn to play a variety of sports and brush up on skills. Instructors teach and reinforce skills development through drills and game play, with a concentration on sportsmanship and friendly competition. Sports vary by season.

name: Adult Wheelchair Basketball at Jesse White

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: For individuals with a primary physical disability. The Chicago Skyhawks are a partnership with the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab (SRALab) and the Chicago Park District for individuals with a primary physical disability to play the amazing game of wheelchair basketball. Through individual and team drills athletes will raise their level of play and gain an understanding of the game. The Skyhawks compete in the National Wheelchair Basketball Association (NWBA) Division III at regional tournaments and events. Indoor wheelchair softball practice will begin on April 9th.

name: Adult Wheelchair Softball at California

age_range.raw_age_text: 14 yrs +

description: Wheelchair Softball is one of the premier sport choices for members of Chicago's adaptive sports community. The program is for people with a primary physical disability to come out and take part in Chicago's sport of choice at Cubs Care Field at California Park; which was one of the first fields in the United States designed for play in the National Wheelchair Softball Association (NWSA). Currently there are two teams of athletes in the program who compete in tournaments throughout the area and if they qualify will move onto the national tournament. For more information please contact Special Recreation Adaptive Sport Program & Event Coordinator Daniel Ferreira for more information: daniel.ferreira@chicagoparkdistrict.com

name: Afro-Caribbean Maypole: Woven Culture at Columbus

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: This event has been canceled due to weather. We look forward to rescheduling on another date.Through dance and rooted rhythms, A 3D Canvas of Woven Culture will take you into a merry-go-round of weaving and unweaving, circling and uncircling, braiding and unbraiding the colors and history of Afro-Caribbean and European exchange through the Maypole dance. You will be invited to dance and wrap to lively Afro-Caribbean drumming and song. The activity will be circled by dance, song, and music representing many of the Afro-Caribbean islands... get a glimpse of the unique performance art traditions. Perhaps it'll help you decide your next vacation. Wherever you go, don't forget your ribbon to show them" what you've got .... trained and true by the West Indian Dance Theater Company of Chicago! https://www.facebook.com/WIDTC

name: AfroSoul Yoga Drum Circle at Euclid

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: A two part event starting with an all inclusive drum circle. The Drum Circle leader gives a brief history on the Djembe, then leads participants through basic rhythms they can play during the dance portion of the event. The 2nd portion is an invigorating, fun for all ages, DANCE focused YOGA. Lively sounds of drums and soul stirring BASS, participants will "DANCE YOUR WAY TO NAMASTE"™? with movements from across the African Diaspora. As an active meditation, all the principles and intention of yoga are the foundation. The dance portion is not about learning the dances to proficiency but using the repetitive movement, freeing your mind and using the breath work needed to execute the various combos to achieve your yoga. In accordance with Be Safe Chicago Guidelines for Parks and Recreation Activities, participants in this activity will be required to wear a mask and practice social distancing at all times while participating. Patrons who are exhibiting any symptoms of COVID-19 are asked to stay home and join us for an event when symptoms subside.

name: Ahimsa: The End of Violence at Dawes

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: “Ahimsa: The End of Violence” presents three classical tales from around the world (Ancient Greece, 19th Century America, and ancient India), narrated and told through classical Indian Bharatanatyam dance to original music compositions. The theme of these tales centers around the futility of violence and the triumph of peace. South Asian American Policy and Research Institute (SAAPRI) will work with Kalapriya again to coordinate a panel of community leaders/activists to hold panel discussions on the themes of "Ahimsa" and productive solutions and responses to violence within the community. The programs will end with audience input and a community dance.

name: America: Songs of Protest and Freedom at Clarendon

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: 2026 marks the 250th anniversary of the United States. America: Songs and Stories of Protest and Freedom is a multi-genre concert of spoken word and music. It’s written and narrated by award-winning journalist, Cheryl Corley, and features a stellar band lead by singer/songwriter Lucy Smith. The concert chronicles America’s story from its founding years to the 21st century. It includes Walt Whitman’s “I Hear America Singing” along with the words of other American authors. Songs include: Curtis Mayfield’s “This is My Country”, John Lennon’s “Imagine,” and Beyonce’s “Freedom.” It is a performance that presents the intricacies of America’s 250 years.

name: An Autumnal Celebration at McKinley

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: A medley of singing, dancing, a fashion show, and other forms of performing arts will be staged to celebrate, in the traditionally oriental way, the family-reuniting festival, one of the grandest festivities honored throughout Asian countries. name: An Introduction to Shamanism at McFetridge

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Meet Your Power Animal & Learn to Journey: An Introduction to Shamanism Introduce yourself to modern Shamanism and its worldwide origins; A way of life combining earthly traditions and spiritual practices teaching us to walk in both worlds. Learn the basic skills of the meditative practice known as Shamanic Journeying: - Create a Sacred Circle - Meet your Power Animal - This Spirit Guide may be a new surprise or an old friend - Journey together to non-ordinary reality - Connect more deeply to Spirit to receive Divine Guidance - Acknowledge your true self and her/his needs - Access information to help you unlock healing relief on many levels By bringing the teachings of shamanism into our daily lives, we can more fully experience our own Divinity, our innate connection to the web of life and dream a new dream for ourselves and the world. Awaken knowledge from deep within you to support "remembering" the Journey of Our Soul. What to bring: Wear comfortable clothing since meditations can be seated or lying down as well as a special blanket or sheet to be on/wrap yourself in and an eye covering (mask or scarf) to help you create a sacred focused space. Other things to bring if you?re called are something sacred to place on the altar, a journal to jot down your insights, a hand drum, or rattle. Please let me know ahead of time if you have a breathing issue which would prevent a smoke smudge since we have an easy alternative. Questions? Contact Monica at (773) 310-1228 or MonicaMoonPlace@gmail.com *Class will be cancelled if 3 participant minimum is not met 3 days prior*

name: Anatomical Circus at Sherman

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Chicago Rewilding Society presents "'Anatomical Circus", an installation of life-size anatomical educational dioramas, anatomical face painting, and animal-assisted therapy with fantastically painted creatures. Anatomical Circus explores our internal and external landscapes, invigorating audiences to celebrate and understand their own humanness through wonder, delight & a sense of magic.

name: Anchor Curatorial Residency Info Session at Ellis

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: Join us for an Anchor Curatorial Residency Info Session at Ellis Park to learn more about the residency, meet the park staff, and ask questions. To learn more or to apply to be the 2026-2027 Anchor Curator-in-Residence, please visit this site.

name: Anchor Residency Welcome Reception at Ellis

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: We invite you to celebrate and meet Lional "Brother El" Freeman at the Anchor Residency Curator Welcome Reception at Ellis Park on Thursday, May 21, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm. Starting at 5:30 pm, you’ll have the chance to mingle with the curator, enjoy local bites from Carver 47, and connect with fellow community members. The evening will culminate with a panel at 6:00 pm featuring past and present Anchor collaborators, and we’ll have the grand debut of our Anchor Monograph! RSVP for event through this link . This monograph, which was published at the end of last year, is now ready to make its way out into the world for you, dear readers. It builds on the success of previous residencies at Austin Town Hall Park and Marquette Park. In partnership with Sixty Inches From Center, an online art publication, the publication critically engages with the residency’s learnings and outcomes, highlighting how municipalities can empower culture workers to address community harm through public/private partnerships. Supported by a grant from the Terra Foundation in 2024 and additional support from the Builder’s Initiative, the monograph was edited by multidisciplinary artist Kamilah Rashied. Anchor Curatorial Residency is a funded Chicago Park District community-driven curatorial residency that rotates among the Chicago Park District’s Cultural Centers. ** About Lional "Brother El" Freeman Brother El is a Chicago-based social practice artist, spontaneous composer, audio engineer, and educator whose work bridges music, community engagement, and public space. Rooted in hip-hop, DIY culture, and South Side Chicago, he is known for his improvised Live PA performances using drum machines, samplers, and synthesizers. He also founded The Beat Bank and creates dynamic public art events, such as Sandbox Symphony, transforming spaces into vibrant, community-centered cultural hubs. Through his work, Brother El expands access to art, uplifts youth and artist communities, and inspires creative possibility. We can’t wait to see his vision come to life at Ellis Park!

name: Angel Bat Dawid at Jackson Park

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: The Art Institute of Chicago presents a performance by Chicago clarinetist and composer Angel Bat Dawid in Jackson Park. Bat Dawid performs her original five-movement suite titled Peace: A Suite for Sky Landing, a Mended Petal Odyssey, composed in response to Yoko Ono’s Skylanding. Bat Dawid performs with the Cosmic Space Arkestra. This event is presented as a part of the City of Chicago’s 2020 Year of Chicago Music. Experience music in the key of Chicago at www.YearofChicagoMusic.org .

name: Animal Tales at Big Marsh

age_range.raw_age_text: Age less than 6 yrs

description: Join the Chicago Public Library, Vodak-East Side Branch at Big Marsh Park for a 30-minute nature-inspired story time directly followed by a 30-minute complementary activity. Activities could include meeting an animal, going on a nature hike, and exploring loose parts and sensory stations. This program is open to all youth and families. Registration is encouraged; walk-ins are welcome. Come early or stay late to explore the nearly 300-acre Natural Area and Bike Park that is Big Marsh Park.

name: Annual Bike Rally at The 606

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: The Third Annual 606 Bike Rally is a collaboration with the Chicago Police Department's 14th and 25th Districts, West Town Bikes and other local community organizations. The rally is a fun, free event that engages and encourages bicycle riders of all ages and abilities. Bike-focused resource partners set up at both the east and west ends of The 606 and provide a wide range of free resources: everything from healthy snacks, tune-ups, quick tutorials, helmet fittings, light and bike bell giveaways, and bike maps and guides are all available. Adding to the festive spirit of the event are bike decorating stations, obstacle courses, a bike washing area and live music from local school bands. This event is free and open to the public.

name: Annual Plant Sale at Kilbourn

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: The 28th Annual Plant Sale will be held in-person at the Kilbourn Park Greenhouse. You can view the list of plants here. Kilbourn Park Greenhouse will offer more than 150 varieties of organically-grown vegetable, herb, edible flower seedlings and so much more. Customers can expect a wide variety of open-pollinated and heirloom tomatoes, peppers, and eggplants. Other highlights include an assortment of herbs, greens and onions. These seedlings are grown with the support of a team of dedicated volunteers who make this Plant Sale possible. Volunteers will be on hand to answer questions about plant selection and planting. This yearly fundraiser supports the greenhouse and our work to connect kids to nature and healthy foods. Also available at the plant sale: Perennials and other plants donated by volunteers of the Kilbourn Park Organic Greenhouse, compost, and bake sale items. Look for the Friends of Kilbourn Park Organic Greenhouse tables just outside the main gate to the gardens. Cost: Free Admission, Plant Prices $4. | cash and credit accepted. We suggest that you bring a box or some type container to carry your purchases.

name: Anything But a Brush at NPV

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: The natural world is full of unique shapes, patterns, and textures. Join Nature Center staff on a walk around the preserve to notice and collect loose natural materials. After our walk, we will return to the Nature Center to create art-the only rule is no paintbrushes! We will use our natural materials to create a unique work of art that celebrates the preserve. Come roll, press, swipe, and stamp with us!

name: A Christmas Carol

age_range.raw_age_text: 8 yrs +

description: Paramount Theatre, Aurora Rediscover the magic of the holiday season with A Christmas Carol , the timeless tale that warms hearts and reminds us all of the true spirit of Christmas. Ebenezer Scrooge, a bitter and lonely miser, is visited on Christmas Eve by three ghosts who take him on a journey through his past, present, and future. Along the way, he learns how to once again experience joy, compassion, and the power of generosity. Whether you’re experiencing Scrooge’s transformation for the first time or reliving the magic of the classic story once again, this play enriched with live music will leave you filled with hope and holiday cheer. Seats are on the main floor. Price includes transportation and theatre ticket. (bn)

name: AARP Smart Driver Course

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Co-sponsored by the AARP and Naperville Park District, this program (formerly known as the AARP Driver Safety Program) is a comprehensive driver-retraining course geared to the specific needs of older motorists. Learn the effects of aging and medications on driving, basic driving rules, license renewal procedures, local traffic hazards and more. Designed to improve your driving abilities through additional training, attention and practice, this two-day course helps you drive more safely and keep your driver's license longer. Most auto insurance companies offer a discount for people who attend this class. Call your local insurance agent for more details. The fee is $25 ($20 for AARP card-carrying members). Fees are subject to change. Payment goes directly to instructor. Make checks payable to AARP. Cash is not accepted. Although it is free to book a spot in the class, there is a fee for this program. (bn)

name: Acrylic Landscapes

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 13 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Young artists can explore their creativity in this enjoyable and fulfilling journey of learning how to paint landscapes. Supply fee is $10 payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Adult CPR Training

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: This is a blended Adult and Pediatric First Aid/CPR/AED learning course. In it, students will learn to recognize and care for a variety of first aid breathing and cardiac emergencies involving adults, children and infants. It is designed for students who need a certification that satisfies OSHA workplace or other regulatory requirements. There is an online portion (accessed via mobile desktop or tablet) that must be completed prior to attending the instructor-led skills session. Upon successful completion a valid 2-year digital certificate for Adult and Pediatric First Aid/CPR/AED is issued. (dn)

name: Adult Hike with a Naturalist

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Join a naturalist on a morning hike to view the autumn colors at Knoch Knolls Park. Dress for the weather. The trails are mostly grassy or dirt paths. Meets on the nature center deck.

name: Advanced Pottery and Sculpture

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Challenge your hand-building and surface decorating skills in a relaxed studio atmosphere with guidance provided based on individual needs and requests. Class work explores unity of form and surface treatment with more complex forms using texture, color, scale and series of objects. Although the class title is "Advanced," only a beginning level of clay work and familiarity with the studio is required. Your inspiration may start with Pinterest, but you will leave the class with art that is uniquely yours. Bring your inspiration, sense of humor and desire to explore your creativity in an environment that fosters personal growth. Each participant receives an individual space to store work. All supplies are included. Prerequisite: participation in a previous Naperville Park District pottery class. (bd)

name: Afternoon Enrichment

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Afternoon Enrichment provides students with opportunities to explore a variety of learning topics through engaging, hands-on activities that strengthen skills in math, science, social studies, art, and early literacy. Each session introduces new experiences designed to spark curiosity, encourage creativity, and support ongoing growth. Participants begin the afternoon by enjoying lunch and playtime with friends before transitioning to their enrichment lab class, where they will engage in exciting, age-appropriate learning activities. Please send a peanut-free lunch. If your child is not enrolled in the park district preschool and has allergies that require an Epi-pen or asthma with an inhaler, please email Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. Afternoon Enrichment does not meet on days that preschool is not in session. No class Oct. 21, Oct. 29, Oct. 30, Nov. 5, Nov. 24-27, Dec. 3 and Dec. 4. (sc)

name: All-Star Baseball Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Kids learn the importance of proper throwing mechanics, rotational hitting, bunting, fielding, pitching and catching. Speed and agility techniques are added to increase core strength and mobility for added bat speed, range in the field and linear speed for base running. In-game strategies are included to increase each player's overall knowledge. Taught by All Star Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: All-Star Basketball Jr.

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Trainers focus on individual skills as well as team play. Each class begins with speed and agility drills to enhance each player's ability to get up and down the court quickly, generate rapid change of direction and create explosion to the basket. Ball handling, proper shooting technique, footwork and defensive/offensive strategies also are included. Small-sided competitions and game play enable each player to focus and work on skills learned. Taught by All Star Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: All-Star Basketball Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Trainers focus on individual skills as well as team play. Each class begins with speed and agility drills to enhance each player's ability to get up and down the court quickly, generate rapid change of direction and create explosion to the basket. Ball handling, proper shooting technique, footwork and defensive/offensive strategies also are included. Small-sided competitions and game play enable each player to focus and work on skills learned. Taught by All Star Sports. (sa)

name: All-Star Parent-Tot Sports

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

description: Enjoy this opportunity to bond and have fun together while learning a variety of sports. Program offers a great opportunity to improve the simple motor skills of catching, throwing, batting, shooting, passing, and running also improving developing hand-eye coordination. Parents participate with their child playing soccer, basketball, hockey, T-Ball, football and other sports. Taught by All Star Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: All-Star Soccer Juniors

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Keep kids active and engaged both mentally and physically in this great base to prepare them for the next level of play. Soccer is a game that is action-packed so there?s no sitting and waiting! The game of soccer is learned by hiding drills in fun games and using association techniques on the players' levels. Simple foot skills, dribbling, passing, shooting, basic rules and even work on spreading the field are covered. Kids also learn teamwork and sportsmanship. Taught by All Stars Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: All-Star Soccer Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: This program includes speed and agility drills to improve each player's soccer game by allowing for a more powerful shot, increased range on the field and efficient change of direction. Basic skills of dribbling, shooting passing and spacing are covered and expanded upon. Players learn the importance of movement away from the ball and the importance of each position through game situations. Taught by All Star Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: All-Star Super Sports

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Designed for the all-around athlete or for a child who wants to "take a shot" at different sports! Kids stay active and work on balance, motor skills and hand-eye coordination while learning the rules of baseball, football, floor hockey, soccer, basketball and more! Each class focuses on a new sport, basic rules and mechanics while games are played that keep everyone moving. There's no reason to pick a sport when they can play them all! Taught by All Star Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: All-Star T-Ball Juniors

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 5 yrs

description: T-Ball can be a boring game if taught incorrectly. This approach to baseball is one that engages players regardless of skill level. They learn basic building blocks in a fun, safe environment. This program keeps players moving and learning even while in the dugout! Mechanics and hand-eye coordination are the keys to early success. Players gain confidence as they learn the proper mechanics of catching, throwing, fielding, base running and batting. This fun, exciting program prepares each player for the Level II, T-Ball or Coach Pitch leagues. Taught by All Star Sports Instruction, Inc. (sa)

name: Annie

age_range.raw_age_text: 8 yrs +

description: Drury Lane Theatre, Oakbrook Terrace Broadway’s favorite little orphan returns to Drury Lane for the first time in over 20 years! This heartwarming musical will delight you and your family during the holiday season with cheer, optimism, and the power of love. Lunch choices are Fresh Filet of Salmon or Roasted Turkey. Price includes transportation, lunch and theatre ticket. If needed, please request a vegetarian, gluten-free or vegan option. Price includes transportation, lunch and theatre ticket. (bn)

name: Archery

age_range.raw_age_text: 9 yrs +

description: Expert instruction in this Olympic sport is provided by a team of National Archery Association-certified instructors who teach target archery in a fun and safe environment. All instruction follows the Junior Olympic Archery Development program guidelines of the NAA. Tight-fitting clothing or short-sleeved shirts are recommended. All equipment is provided; please do not bring or buy any gear. Fee is per person. (fg)

name: Baby Rock

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3m but less than 1y 3m

description: Wiggle and giggle with Baby Rock! This program is a unique combination of sensory experiences with stimulating music and exercises to help strengthen and stretch your baby. Activities will include sing-alongs, exposure to simple instruments and sensory props, motion exercises, bubbles, and more! Please bring a blanket or mat and get ready for a rockin' good time with your tiniest dancer! This Class is intended for non-walkers. www.rockitkids.com (sl)

name: Babysitter Training

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 17 yrs

description: The American Red Cross Babysitter’s Training with Adult and Pediatric First Aid/CPR/AED - BL course prepares youth ages 11-16 to care for children and infants safely and confidently. It includes hands-on activities videos and discussions to develop essential real-life readiness babysitting skills. The course safely covers feeding, diapering, picking up and holding children safety and how to respond in an emergency. Since CPR can be physically demanding, participants should weigh at least 85-90 pounds. This blended learning course also includes an online portion and an instructor-led classroom skill session. The online portion, which must be completed prior to attending the in-person training, and must be taken on a PC or tablet with a high-speed Internet connection. Allow approximately 3 hours to complete the online portion. Upon successful completion of both the online and in person portions of the course, a valid 10-year Babysitter's Training digital certification and a valid 2-year digital certificate for Pediatric First Aid/CPR/AED is issued. (dn)

name: Balance, Breath and Movement (hybrid)

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Balance, Breath and Movement focus on functional movement for daily life. Exercises are drawn from Chinese Qi Gongs and Tai Chi movements that work on balance and flexibility, as well as breathing techniques, to enhance the movements and relieve stress. All can be done seated if needed. (jg)

name: Ballet Basics

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Looking to enter the world of ballet? Younger and beginning dancers are able to explore dance and expand their ballet knowledge in this program focused on classroom etiquette, posture, ballet terminology and intricate positions of the feet, arms and body in a creative and expressive environment. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Ballet Basics Recital

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Looking to enter the world of ballet? Younger and beginning dancers are able to explore dance and expand their ballet knowledge in this program focused on classroom etiquette, posture, ballet terminology and intricate positions of the feet, arms and body in a creative and expressive environment. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Ballet/Tap Basics

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program is designed to build a solid dance foundation. Dancers learn proper posture and technique while being introduced to dance terminology from both dance styles. The program focuses on the fundamentals of ballet technique, incorporating tap to help with rhythm, tempo and distribution of weight. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program is designed to build a solid dance foundation. Dancers learn proper posture and technique while being introduced to dance terminology from both dance styles. The program focuses on the fundamentals of ballet technique, incorporating tap to help with rhythm, tempo and distribution of weight. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Ballet: Adult

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Learn the fundamentals of ballet while lengthening and strengthening your body and increasing your flexibility. This program is perfect for students new to ballet or those looking to return to the art. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Ballet: Beginner

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Dancers begin their ballet training learning basic ballet exercises while incorporating musicality and rhythm and focusing on classroom etiquette, posture, ballet terminology and positions of the feet, arms and body. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Ballet: Level 1

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: This program incorporates basic barre exercises and center work focusing on arm and head coordination, rhythm, correct body alignment, change of direction and poise. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Ballet: Level 1

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: This program incorporates basic barre exercises and center work focusing on arm and head coordination, rhythm, correct body alignment, change of direction and poise. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Baseball: Men's 25 and Over League

age_range.raw_age_text: 25 yrs +

description: Enjoy camaraderie and competitive, fast play in our men's 25 and over baseball league. League play follows modified IHSA rules. Teams usually have one weeknight and one Sunday game per week. Individuals interested in playing may email batwell@napervilleparks.org to be added to our interest list. Names are provided to team managers who may be seeking additional players. Team fees are as listed plus $20 per nonresident player. All players must be 25 years of age by September 13, 2026. (ba)

name: Basketball: Hudson Sportsplex 3 v 3 League

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Friday Night 3v3 Basketball League is designed to provide players with more game reps, increased decision-making opportunities, and a fun competitive environment focused on skill development and basketball IQ. Max roster size is 6 players per team; players may register individually or as a full team and may wear matching jerseys/shirts of their choice. Standings and weekly schedules are provided. (fg)

name: Basketball: Hudson Sportsplex Basketball Camps

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Led by the professional Hudson Sportsplex basketball coaching staff, participants will enhance their skills on the court with a high-repetition, game-application focused training routine. (fg)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

name: Basketball: Jump City

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Coach Tony Ivkovich and his Jump City Basketball staff lead players through the fundamentals of basketball. Participants are grouped according to ability and learn game basics using drills, scrimmages and contests. (fg)

name: Basketball: Men's 35 and Over A League

age_range.raw_age_text: 35 yrs +

description: Get back into the game! Stay in shape and enjoy camaraderie, fun and competitive play. Registration is processed by team; however, individuals may sign up on our interest list and we'll provide their names to team captains needing additional players. This is a 10-game season with single elimination playoffs. (fg)

age_range.raw_age_text: 35 yrs +

This is a 10-game season with single elimination playoffs. (fg)

If we get enough individuals, we can create our own team or we can send the list to the captains. This does not guarantee placement and a fee would apply once placed. (fg)

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

This special Halloween edition of bingo features a festive luncheon of 4-inch Italian beef sandwich and mostaccioli with marinara from Portillio's, along with 12 games of regular bingo, great company, and if you’re lucky, exciting prizes. Costumes are encouraged, but not required. (bn)

name: Chess Wizards

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Chess Wizards is a premier chess education company providing fun, informative and challenging chess lessons. Participants also will learn important life concepts including learning the ability to win graciously and accept defeat with dignity and sportsmanship. Students are grouped according to their chess experience. Each student has the chance to participate in a mini chess tournament by the end of the session. (bd)

name: Choreography Mastery: Level 1/2

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Dancers will explore a variety of styles, including jazz, modern, hip-hop, lyrical, and more. Each session introduces fresh combinations that challenge technique, musicality, and expression, allowing students to expand their movement vocabulary while building confidence and versatility. The class emphasizes both precision and artistry, encouraging dancers to connect with the music and tell a story through movement. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Club Silly Scientists

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: High Touch High Tech Chicagoland is ready to help inspire your little scientists! This class will be filled with hands-on STEAM experimenting. We will explore new topics in the sciences. Every day will be a fun filled scientific surprise where we will explode volcanoes, touch real squid, or go panning for gemstones and so much more in every session. To wrap up each day your scientists will come home with a take home experiment they worked on with us that relates to the topic we taught. Please bring a spill-proof water bottle. Each session will cover all new material throughout the year. (bd)

name: Code Ninjas-North

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Code Ninjas is a coding center designed specifically for kids in a unique dojo-inspired learning environment. This program emphasizes project-based learning, where students build real games and apps, ensuring that they gain practical hands-on experience with coding. Educational concepts taught in this program include basic programming principles, game development, app creation, logical thinking and problem solving, mathematics and computational thinking, teamwork and collaboration, user interface design, debugging and troubleshooting. Code Ninjas North is located at 2765 Maple Ave. in Lisle just east of Naper Blvd. (jg)

name: Creating Art Journals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Join us to create a unique art journal that will become a cherished keepsake for generations to come. Our class will employ a variety of creative techniques to inspire and unleash your child’s artistic potential. Each piece will be uniquely their own. The materials provided include a hardcover journal book, specialized cardstock papers, miniature envelopes, acrylic markers, pencils, stamps, stickers and lots more. (bd)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: This sensory art clay workshop is designed for a wider age range to accommodate all skill levels. In our encouraging and fun setting, students will create unique objects with air-dry clay. For this 4-week class, held in October, themed project ideas for making ghosts, cats and hats will be presented for inspiration. Children will use their imagination to sculpt their pieces and decorate them with vibrant water-based paint and various decorative materials for the final touches. All clay, decorations and art supplies included. Have your creative minds dressed to play with clay. (bd)

name: Creating with Clay: Holiday Ornaments and 3D Winter Trees

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Join us for a workshop that’s perfect for any young creator who loves getting their hands dirty! In our supportive environment, students will be encouraged to create their own one-of-a-kind items using air-dry clay. We’ll share project ideas sparking kids’ imagination as they sculpt and decorate with bright water-based paint and fun decorative materials. All the clay, decorations, and art supplies are included. Get ready to unleash your artistic side with clay! This December the theme is holiday ornaments and 3D trees. (bd)

name: Decorative Folk Art Painting for Beginners

price.raw_price_text: Resident: $74.00; Non-resident: $104.00; Senior, 60 and over, resident: $59.20; Senior, 60 and over, non-resident: $83.20

Participants will receive a solid foundation for this wonderful decorative art form. No previous painting or drawing experience is required. All you need is a desire to learn and a willingness to practice. All supplies are available for a fee of $25 payable to instructor at the first class. (bd)

name: Engineering & STEAM, Dream It, Design, It, Create It

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Join High Touch High Tech Chicagoland’s Science Made Fun team as we lead our future scientists in an exciting engineering workshop. Your future scientists will explore mechanical, electrical, and chemical engineering with us as we work to build catapults and facilitators, bug bots, and some chemically powered rockets. At the end, participants will take home what they create! Please bring a nut-free snack and spill-proof water bottle. (bd)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

We will cover experiments like volcanic eruptions, fizzy bombs, geyser tubes (the infamous Diet Coke and Mentos experiment), and so much more on this explosive bubbly day. Participants will take home the experiments they created. Lab coats and goggles are included for this event. Please bring a nut-free snack and spill-proof water bottle. (bd)

Similar to Tot Rock and Kid Rock, Family Rock is a movement-based learning and imaginative play classes with music. Activities include songs and rhymes, rhythm and coordination, fine and gross motor, imagination and sensory, and listening and following directions. New curriculum is presented each session. This is a parent/child class. www.rockitkids.com (sl)

name: Fencing: Adult

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Fencing is a recreational and competitive sport that incorporates agility, strength, coordination, balance and timing. This program focuses on the discipline and training in foil. A foil is a thrusting weapon with a thin, flexible blade and a small, round bell guard. This program runs concurrently in the same room as the club program with adults and children fencing together. Equipment is provided. (fg)

name: Fencing: Youth

age_range.raw_age_text: 10 yrs +

description: Fencing is a recreational and competitive sport that incorporates agility, strength, coordination, balance and timing. This program focuses on the discipline and training in foil. A foil is a thrusting weapon with a thin, flexible blade and a small, round bell guard. Coach Peter Habala is a five-time National Champion from Team Romania. He has been fencing competitively for over 35 years and is the head coach of RedStar Fencing Club Chicago. Equipment is provided for beginning and intermediate participants; participants enrolled in Fencing Club should purchase their own electric equipment. Participants must have completed beginning fencing and have instructor approval before signing up for intermediate fencing and instructor approval to sign up for Club Fencing. (fg)

name: Fitness: Ageless Grace®: Timeless Fit for the Body and Mind

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Welcome to Ageless Grace®: Timeless Fit for the Body and Mind, a cutting-edge brain fitness program based on neuroplasticity that activates all five functions of the brain-strategic planning, memory/recall, analytical thinking, creativity and imagination and kinesthetic learning while simultaneously addressing all 21 physical skills needed for lifelong optimal function. This unique program works for all ages and all fitness and ability levels. Instructor Cecilia Floyd-Carruthers will teach you the 21 Tools that focus on different anti-aging techniques like Shake It Up Baby, Dance Party, Spaghetti Spine and more, all set to lively and familiar music. Just imagine all of this plus tons of laughter. Stretch, bend and strengthen your core muscles while adding the twist of cognitive learning to build those brain cells. This program works by providing increased stability while seated in a chair! It's time to add fun to exercise and experience the newest way to move both mind and body. Please note that this class is done barefoot while sitting in a chair. Bring comfy socks if needed. No class Sat., Sept. 5, Nov. 28 and Dec. 5. (bn)

name: Fitness: Balance, Breath and Movement (hybrid)

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Balance, Breath and Movement focus on functional movement for daily life. Exercises are drawn from Chinese Qi Gongs and Tai Chi movements that work on balance and flexibility, as well as breathing techniques, to enhance the movements and relieve stress. All can be done seated if needed. (bn)

name: Fitness: Regain Your Balance

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Taught by instructor Cecilia Floyd-Carruthers, Regain Your Balance is specifically designed for seniors who are currently mobile and able to support themselves without assistance. As seniors progress and notice a decline in cognitive function, the biggest fear is falling. Consisting of three 15-minute segments of sitting, standing and walking, this class will help you build your confidence and regain or maintain your balance. Fall prevention and how to correctly fall to avoid injuries will be discussed. Please bring water for hydration and wear gym shoes with good support. In order to participate in the Regain Your Balance class, you must be mobile and able to support yourself without assistance. No class Sat., Sept. 5, Nov. 28 and Dec. 5. (bn)

name: Fitness: Senior Kung Fu

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Senior Kung Fu is for the active senior looking for a different type of exercise. Come and have fun learning something new! The class consists of exercises, stance training, Kung Fu Forms (routines of movements), staff routines and two-person applications. (bn)

name: Fitness: Senior Stretch

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Most exercise classes include stretching during warmup and cool down, but what about an entire class dedicated to this important activity? Stretching is vital for seniors and allows for greater movement in joints while improving overall posture in addition to releasing muscle tension and soreness, reducing the risk of injury. It also may help increase circulation, muscle control and improve balance and coordination. This 30-minute class, taught by Cecilia Floyd-Carruthers, covers stretching exercises from head to toe in a seated position as well as standing, using a chair for balance. Please bring water for hydration and wear gym shoes with good support. In order to participate in the Senior Stretch class, you must be mobile and able to support yourself without assistance. No class Sat., Sept. 5, Nov. 28 and Dec. 5. (bn)

name: Fitness: Tai Chi: Adult & Senior-Practice and Instructional

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Looking for better balance, gentle movement, stress relief and moving meditation? Tai Chi might be just what you are looking for and it will complement your other exercise routines. The many benefits of Tai Chi including maintaining mobility, agility, health and vitality can be found in these simple movements. See why Tai Chi has been practiced for centuries to benefit the mind and body. Practice vs Instructional Classes: Practice classes have minimal instruction allowing the student to just follow along in the various exercises and movements to focus on relaxing and breathing. Every level Practice class has a corresponding level Instructional class. Instructional classes provide detailed explanation of everything contained in the Practice class. Ideally, a student would take both. Adult vs Senior Classes: Adult and Senior Tai Chi classes have the same content and instruction. Senior classes are priced for those 50 and over. Anyone 60 and over can register for an Adult Tai Chi class and receive a 20% senior discount. In Person vs Virtual vs Hybrid: Some classes are in person only; some are virtual only (via Zoom) and some are hybrid. Hybrid classes are simultaneously offered in person and via Zoom. If you cannot attend an in-person class on a specific date, you can participate at home via Zoom. (jg)

During the winter months, walks occur indoors at the Fox Valley Mall. If you are new, please call 630-848-5000 to confirm the departure location. (bn)

The group performs in shows in the Chicago area a few times during the year. It is expected that participants also will register for the winter session. (fg)

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

This will be a slow (less than 1 mile) mindful walk connecting to nature through your senses. The walk will conclude with a tea ceremony made from organic tea plants from the therapist's garden. The walk is held entirely outdoors. Wear comfortable clothing and walking shoes. Meets on the nature center deck. Support for this program provided by the DuPage Foundation. (ah)

Class is commonly repeated before the instructor recommends moving up to Tumbling 2. Tumbling 2 students will learn handstand forward roll, front limber, back walkover and round off. They may also begin working on back and front handsprings. Instructors reserve the right to move students to appropriate levels. Gymnasts must be 6 years old by September 1, 2026 and in first grade to begin this program. (dn)

name: Halloween Hayride

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: Calling all witches, wizards, ghosts and goblins! Dress up in your favorite Halloween costume (parents included) and join us for a Halloween Hayride. Each registered child ages 3-12 years receives a Halloween goodie bag. You may bring your own food to cook over the bonfire or bring the fixings for s'mores. We provide hot chocolate and apple cider. No alcohol allowed. Please bring your own stick or skewer for roasting. Some picnic tables are provided; you may bring your own chairs and blankets. Please bring flashlights and insect repellent. For rainout information, please visit napervilleparks.org. Children under three may ride for free and do not need to be registered. Each child and adult attending must register. This is a per person event. (dn)

name: Hayrides: Family

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: Round up the family and take a hayride in the crisp autumn air through a beautiful Naperville park. You may bring your own food to cook over the bonfire or bring the fixings for s'mores. We provide hot chocolate and apple cider. No alcohol allowed. Picnic tables are provided. Bring your own chairs, blankets, flashlights and insect repellent. For rainout information, please visit napervilleparks.org. Children under three may ride for free and do not need to be registered. Each child and adult attending must register. This is a per person event. (dn)

name: Hayrides: Group

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: Group rental includes use of the park, 20-minute hayrides and a campfire. You may bring your own food to cook over the bonfire. We provide hot chocolate and apple cider. No alcohol allowed. Picnic tables are provided. Bring your own chairs, blankets, flashlights and insect repellent. Youth groups must provide adult supervision on a 1:10 ratio. You must be at least 21 to rent the hayride rack. For groups with over 30 people, there is an additional charge of $5 per participant over the 30 attendees. A deposit of $150 paid with a credit/debit card or electronic check will be required at the time of registration. An automatic payment for the remaining balance and any additional extra participant fees will be made 5 days after your event. For rainout information, please visit napervilleparks.org. Children under 3 may ride for free and do not need to be registered. Cancellations must be made 21 days in advance. (dn)

name: Hi-Five Sports Parent/Tot Multi-Sport

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 7 yrs

description: Become a multi-sport all-star with Hi-Five! We know it’s important to keep this age group engaged so we will introduce a new team sport every 2 weeks. Hi-Five Multi-Sport serves as an introduction to some of the most popular sports in the world including football, soccer, basketball, and more! Children learn the fundamentals of each game through various drills and training elements designed specifically for young players. While this program focuses on player development and the overall understanding of each sport, it also stresses FUN! Hi-Five’s ultimate goal is to help each child build strong physical, intellectual and emotional foundations that will help them succeed on and off of the field! Class is lead by Hi-Five Sports. (sa)

name: Hip Hop/Jazz

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: This program provides a structured method of learning various hip-hop and jazz dance moves in a fun-filled, vibrant environment. It focuses on age-appropriate dance steps and music. Kids love combining street dance with funk and jazz, similar to what they see in televised dance performances or music videos. This progressive program challenges dancers in a variety of hip-hop and jazz techniques. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Hip Hop/Jazz Fusion

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Filled with great music and good times, this program provides a structured method of learning various hip-hop and jazz dance moves in a fun-filled, vibrant environment. It focuses on age-appropriate dance steps and music. Kids love combining street dance with funk and jazz, similar to what they see in televised dance performances or music videos. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: Learn the fundamentals of hip hop dance while strengthening and toning your body and increasing your flexibility. This program is perfect for students new to hip hop dance or those looking to return to the art. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

This program is perfect for students new to hip hop dance or those looking to return to the art. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program introduces the hip-hop phenomenon to the younger dancer. Students learn basic technique while building strength, balance and musicality. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Hippity Hoppers Recital

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program introduces the hip-hop phenomenon to the younger dancer. Students learn basic technique while building strength, balance and musicality. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Holiday Evergreen Centerpiece

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Learn basic floral design skills while creating a beautiful fresh evergreen centerpiece. Class work will explore tools, evergreen identification, shape, use of textures, floral care and personalization ideas. Design will include fresh evergreens, pinecones, other natural items, seasonal trim and ribbons. All supplies, including tools, are provided but you may bring and add personal touches. (ah)

name: Home Safety

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: This course will teach children/tweens how to be safe when they are home alone. Topics covered include Fire Prevention, Water, Internet, Strangers and Electrical Safety. (dn)

name: Ice Skating: All Seasons Ice Arena

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Our Staff Coaches at All Seasons Ice Rinks make learning to skate fun and safe for people of all ages and abilities. We follow the curriculum designed by Learn To Skate USA; each level builds upon the skills already mastered. We suggest wearing helmets, gloves/mittens, athletic-like pants, and a warm jacket. We offer skate rental for $24 for each 7-week session or $4 weekly. Free practice times for all class times and one makeup allowed per session. Please call 630-851-0755 or visit www.allseasonsicerinks.com for questions or additional information. (dn)

name: Ice Skating: Rocket Ice

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: The goal at Rocket Ice Arena is to provide a fun and safe environment for skaters to learn to skate and to be able to continue on in hockey or figure skating. From tot and up, lessons are presented in concise levels with each one focusing on skills that will serve as building blocks for future levels. After demonstrating mastery in one level, the student skater may proceed to the next. The curriculum works in conjunction with USFS Basic Skills Program that is taught in quality rinks worldwide. Please wear athletic pants and fleece jacket or similar fitted and warm jacket and bring gloves. Helmets are recommended. We have skates available to rent. Please call 630-679-1700 or visit Rocketice.com if you have any questions. (dn)

name: Ice Skating: Seven Bridges

age_range.raw_age_text: 3 yrs +

description: The Seven Bridges Ice Arena philosophy is that anyone can learn to ice skate if they try their best. All ice skating programs feature experienced instructors and free practice sessions. For practice times and more information, please contact Seven Bridges at 630-271-4400. Gloves/mittens and helmets are recommended for skaters and hockey players. Buddy passes are $2 (skate rental not included). Skate rentals are $4 each or 11 for $40. Only one makeup class is allowed per session. (dn) Tots 1 (ages 4-5) - Beginners with no previous instruction. Parent/Tot (ages 3-5) - Beginners with no previous instruction. Basic 1 (ages 6-13) - Beginners with no previous instruction. name: Introduction to Quilting

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Join us for an introductory quilting class, no experience needed! Participants will learn how to thread a machine, wind a bobbin, and learn to sew a basic quilt. Sewing machines will be provided for use in class. If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. Supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Introduction to Sewing

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Join us for an introductory sewing class! In this class you will learn how to thread a machine, wind a bobbin, and sew straight lines. Sewing machines will be provided for use in class. If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. A supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Intuitive Painting

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: In this transformative class, you'll explore intuitive painting as a way to quiet the mind and follow the natural energy of your body. Rather than focusing on technique or outcome, you'll engage in open ended, process-based exploration, allowing images and emotions to emerge freely on the page. Whether you're new to painting or returning to your creative roots, this practice invites spontaneity, reflection, and personal insight. Included, or bring your own brush set, fast-drying paints, and paper or canvas. (bd)

name: Irish Dance

age_range.raw_age_text: 5 yrs +

description: Learn reels, jigs, hornpipes and figure dancing. Instructors introduce the excitement of Irish dance and culture. Students must have teacher approval to enroll in the Advanced Level. (sl)

name: Jazz Funk: Level 4/5 Recital

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 13 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Jazz/Funk combines jazz dance fundamentals and hip hop elements with an emphasis on isolations, syncopation and personal style. This high energy class will challenge dancers to learn fast paced choreography to a variety of popular songs with a focus on stage presence, upper body movements, footwork, and floor/tumbling skills. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Jazz: Level 2

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Dancers build technique and begin to use strengthening exercises to build stamina and increase their knowledge of jazz footwork and style. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Jazz: Level 3

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Students expand their jazz dancing with more complicated rhythms and syncopation, build their dance vocabulary, use various dynamics and tempos and investigate numerous styles of jazz. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618.*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Jazz: Level 4

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 13 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Dancers begin to work on more stylized and advanced movements in the technique and perfect their performance quality and artistry. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. name: Jazz: Level 5

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 15 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Dancers begin to work on more stylized and advanced movements in the technique and perfect their performance quality and artistry. ***Prerequisite of the previous level or equivalent experience is required. For questions on placement, please contact the Dance Coordinator at tlight@napervilleparks.org or 630-848-3618*** Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. name: Jr. Clinics: Ages 11-15

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 16 yrs

description: The Junior Clinic experience is designed for young people with little or no golf background. Learn the basic fundamentals of putting, chipping, full swing and etiquette and receive a four-token range punch card - a $40 value. Participants should provide their own clubs. A driver or fairway wood, the 7, 9, Pw or Sw irons and a putter are recommended. If you do not have clubs. we have clubs available at no charge. Participants also are eligible for a discount on club purchases in our Golf Shops. For rainout information, call the Springbrook Golf Shop at 630-848-5060. (ml)

name: Jr. Clinics: Ages 7-10

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 11 yrs
