(ml, jw)

name: Jr. Clinics: Ages 7-10

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: This Junior Clinic is designed for young aspiring golfers with little to no experience. Learn the basic fundamentals of putting, chipping, full swing and etiquette and receive a four-token range punch card - a $40 value. Please provide your own clubs. A fairway wood, the 5, 7, 9 irons and a putter are recommended. We have a limited number of junior golf clubs available at no charge that can be reserved on a first come, first served basis by contacting the Golf Shop where the lesson is held. If you have clubs, please bring them. You also are eligible for a discount on club purchases in our Golf Shops. For rainout information, call the Naperbrook Golf Shop at 630-378-4215. (ml, dh)

name: Kid Rock

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs

description: Sing, dance, play, learn, and imagine with us! This movement-based program uses music to facilitate learning. Students will use rhythm instruments and movement props, work on gross and fine motor skills, including balance and coordination, and engage in imaginative play. All classes are structured and include early listening and following directions skills. Join us for a rockin’ good time! www.rockitkids.com (sl)

name: Kids First Badminton Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Playing badminton is fun, whether as a hobby or on a more competitive level. Players are introduced to fundamental badminton skills using drills and scrimmages. Emphasis includes grip, racquet positioning, serving, body balance and first step directional movement. Program concludes with a skills challenge and championship match. Fee includes all equipment. Led by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Baseball Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Batter up! This program challenges all players through fun, competitive drills and games that maximize player potential. Program teaches batting techniques, body balance, throwing, fielding, first-step directional movements, pitching, base running and sportsmanship. It concludes with a championship game. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Players should bring a baseball glove and water bottle. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Basketball Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Learn the basics of basketball with hands-on drills, demonstrations, scrimmages and skills contests leading to the championship game on the last day. Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff focuses on shooting, ball-handling, offensive and defensive skills. Quickness, body balance, first step directional movements, safety and sportsmanship are emphasized. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Cheerleading Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Experienced coaches teach cheer techniques, body balance movements, timing, rhythm, jumps, stunts, cheers and sportsmanship. The final day features a cheer challenge contest. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Dodgeball

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Have a blast running, throwing, dodging and ducking your way to victory. The sport of dodgeball provides great team competition and individual challenge matches. Parents are invited to watch the championship match on the last day. Soft, super-safe balls are used. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Football Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This football program teaches player position fundamentals preparing to play flag and tackle football. Football has twenty-two positions (excluding special teams players) that take time to learn and understand their purpose. The more a player learns, the more confident they become. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. In case of rainout, a makeup is scheduled the week following the end of the session. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Multi-Sport Program

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Experienced Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. coaches teach different sports each day giving kids a chance to learn about new sports and play their favorites. General rules are introduced including safety and fundamentals, and then the game is played. Choices may include basketball, baseball/softball, soccer, flag football, badminton, kickball, volleyball, dodgeball and balloon ball. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Softball Skills

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Batter up! This program challenges all players through fun, competitive drills and games that maximize player potential. Program teaches batting techniques, body balance, throwing, fielding, first-step directional movements, pitching, base running and sportsmanship. It concludes with a championship game. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Players should bring their glove and water bottle. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Speed/Quickness Training

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Playing almost any sport requires quickness. Experienced Kids First coaches teach first step directional movements used in football, track, baseball and soccer. Sport specific drills per sport include individual and team challenge contests. Each participant has an opportunity to learn the quickness component involved for multiple player positions for each sport. General rules of the sport being played are explained; safety and fundamental demonstrations are provided. The last session hosts individual and team challenge contests. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Track & Field Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Learn all about the timed events that make up the sport of track and field. Coaches teach sprints, hurdles, jumps, distance running and throws in a safe and fundamental way. Learn new techniques and strengthen existing skills. There is a mini-meet on the final day. Conducted by coaches from Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids First Ultimate Frisbee® Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Ultimate Frisbee® is a simple team sport that has been described as a combination of football, soccer and basketball. Certified coaches prepare players to play, enjoy and be successful. Learn basic rules, how to throw and score points offensively and how to protect the goal defensively. Parents are invited to the championship match at the end of the last day. In case of rainout, time will be added equally to remaining sessions. Taught by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. (ba)

name: Kids First Volleyball Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Get started playing the fun, action-packed game of volleyball. Players learn fundamental techniques incorporating balance, directional movements, ball handling and sportsmanship through skills drills, visual volleyball safety instruction and games. Conducted by Kids First Sports Safety, Inc. staff. Parents are asked to remain outside of the gym. (ba)

name: Kids' Night Out: Gingerbread Hunt

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Enjoy the night out while your kids have their own fun making Santa hats, decorating cookies, making a Gingerbread Man and having a Gingerbread Hunt. Dinner and juice are provided. Fort Hill Activity Center Fitness members must register in person or over the phone to receive their discount. (km)

name: Kids' Night Out: Gobble Gobble Fun

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Enjoy the night out while your kids have their own fun night filled with Turkey crafts, playing Turkey Relay Races, Pin the Wattle on the Turkey and more. Dinner and juice are provided. Fort Hill Activity Center Fitness members must register in person or over the phone to receive their discount. (km)

name: Kids' Night Out: Spooktacular

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Enjoy the night out while your kids have a fun evening painting pumpkins, playing Bingo, participating in Mummy Relay Races, Monster Freeze Dance and more. Kids are invited to dress up in their costumes if they would like. Dinner and juice are provided. Fort Hill Activity Center Fitness members must register in person or over the phone to receive their discount. (km)

name: Kids' Night Out: Superhero Night

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Enjoy the night out while your kids have a fun night enjoying a superhero hunt, obstacle course and writing a letter to their favorite superhero. Dinner and juice are provided. Fort Hill Activity Center Fitness members must register in person or over the phone to receive their discount. (km)

name: Lacrosse: Orange Crush Intro to Lacrosse

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Designed for participants who are new to the sport, this introductory program offers a fun opportunity to try lacrosse without the expense or commitment of purchasing equipment. Participants will learn the fundamental skills and basic concepts of the game in a supportive environment. No equipment is required. (sa)

name: Lacrosse: Orange Crush Lacrosse Skills & Scrimmage

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Both new and experienced lacrosse players will benefit from this action-packed instructional program from Orange Crush. This immersive program will instruct players on game essentials, equipment use, skills, sportsmanship and more to help players build their understanding of the strategy of the game while fostering enjoyment of the sport and developing future athletes. Equipment Requirements: Pre-K-K: stick, mouth guard, and athletic footwear and athletic clothing Boys 1st-8th Grade: stick, mouth guard, helmet, gloves, shoulder pads, elbow pads, athletic clothing and athletic footwear Girls 1st-8th: stick, mouth guard, goggles, athletic clothing and athletic footwear. (sa)

name: Landscape Secrets

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Study how master landscape artists used the fundamentals of successful painting to create their extraordinary works. After exploring the techniques of these renowned artists, you'll apply what you've learned to your own landscape paintings. The instructor is trained in watercolor, acrylic, pastel and oil, so bring your favorite medium! (bd)

name: Laugh Out Loud Improv

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 14 yrs

description: Love to laugh? Then this class is for you! Through fast-paced improv games, creative challenges and sketch comedy, you'll build memorable characters, think on your feet and discover the fun of spontaneous performance. Along the way, you'll boost your confidence, strengthen communication and teamwork skills, and share plenty of laughs in a supportive, high-energy environment. No acting experience is necessary, just bring your imagination and willingness to have fun! (sl)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 13 yrs

name: Li'l Artists: Cool Crafts

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Bring your inner creative spirit along to this class that is all about crafts. Create a new craft project each day! Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Builders

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Put on your hard hat and join us as we explore, create and build using a variety of mediums. Arts projects, activities and games are geared toward working constructively to build new creations. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Busy Bees

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 4 yrs

description: Li'l Busy Bees is designed with toddlers in mind. This parent and child program focuses on having fun while engaging in hands-on experiences. Each week brings new activities for children to explore through art, music, sensory activities and movement, with an opportunity for both parent and child to socialize and form new friendships. Infants in carriers are welcome. No class Oct. 21, Nov. 23-26. (sc)

name: Li'l Paleontologist

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Journey to the prehistoric land of dinosaurs. This class incorporates arts, crafts, games and stories to teach pint-sized paleontologists about these amazing extinct creatures. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Scientist: Slime & Grime

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Combine one part science and two parts imagination with some household knowledge and a little dirt. The outcome includes excitingly unusual activities, games and experiments that are sure to capture your attention and make you say WOW! This class is messy; please dress appropriately. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. If your child has allergies or asthma that require an Epi-pen or inhaler to accompany your child, please contact Sara Cass at scass@napervilleparks.org to complete the necessary paperwork at least 5 days before the start of class. (sc)

name: Li'l Sprouts

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2y 6m but less than 4 yrs

description: Li'l Sprouts is a fun, learning-based program designed for children who are not quite ready to be away from their parent. Participants have the opportunity to ease into being independent in a classroom setting, with an environment that helps them feel safe and secure in their surroundings. To start, each child will have a parent in their class while they take the time to familiarize themselves with the classroom, the class routine and develop a relationship with their teacher. During the final 2 weeks of the program, participants transition to attending class on their own; this transition may be adjusted to fit the needs of the class. No class Nov. 24 & 26. (sc)

name: Little Actors' Club

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Children love this innovative drama class that develops their imagination and introduces them to the performing arts in a fun and creative atmosphere. Each week is a new and exciting adventure into the imagination with changing themes, costumes or props, music, and games. Participants learn theater terms, a short song, and a new joke every week, enhance spontaneity, build self-esteem, and have plenty of fun in this delightful class. Every session is different and most themes are not repeated for two years so “act” now! (sl)

name: Lyrical/Modern/Contemporary

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Our Lyrical classes offer a first step towards our Modern/Contemporary classes while still working towards building the dancers ballet technique. Modern/Contemporary combines stretching and strengthening to lengthen a dancer's muscles and body. Extensive center warmup and cross floor material is taught. Core strength is developed to facilitate execution of skills and follows traditional styles of movement. This program explores the qualities of released and off-balance dancing while daring students to find disparate qualities of stillness and explosion. Students are encouraged to develop an individual style driven by their internal life and the specificity of their bodies. Prior ballet and/or jazz experience required. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Martial Arts: ISKC Karate Adult

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

description: Illinois Shotokan Karate Club (ISKC) is Chicagoland's premier karate school taught under the instruction of john DiPasquale, a four-time nation Champion, US National Coach and President of the US National Karate Federation. The adult program releases tension, develops total body fitness and builds stamina and overall productivity! In addition to self-defense skills, karate increases flexibility, cardiovascular endurance and muscle tone while improving core strength. (fg) Uniforms and Belt-Testing are options available through the ISKC instructor. Youth, Parent/Child and Adult Classes may train together. Beginner students are not permitted to register for the current session after the second class has met. Registration for continuers through the advanced students is accepted after the start date, but payment of the full fee is required.

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This progressive martial arts program teaches the basics in karate, self-defense, sparring, kata and children's safety with belt progression through Black Belt. It is taught in a unique way where children are encouraged to have fun and gain confidence. The program targets many building blocks including respect, self-esteem, self-confidence and leadership, but most importantly, family involvement. Parents may participate with their children at no cost as part of the Parent Helper Program. There is a Mandatory Uniform Requirement required for this program, details will be give at first class. For more information, visit www.kidskarate.com. (fg)

name: Martial Arts: Kids Kung Fu

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: The focus in all levels is on building character and personal achievement and not in aggression and competition. Students earn increasingly higher belts as they progress in knowledge and abilities. Information regarding additional costs for T-shirts required for Level 2 & 3 will be discussed at first class and will be purchased directly through instructor. (bn) Level 1 - Students begin with simple exercises and routines that develop confidence and self-discipline as well as build coordination and strength. Level 2 - Students proceed through more difficult routines that demand a higher level of focus and concentration. Two-person Kung Fu practice is introduced that allows the students to develop their skills together. Instructor approval is required. Level 3 - This level is for those students that are on the road to their Kung Fu Black Belt. Training in child-appropriate staff and sword is introduced along with child-appropriate martial arts applications. Instructor approval is required.

name: Mean Girls

age_range.raw_age_text: 21 yrs +

description: Paramount Theatre, Aurora This hilarious musical has heart, telling the story of Cady Heron, a sweet and smart new girl who has just moved from Africa to suburban Illinois. When she enters the wild world of North Shore High, she quickly finds herself tangled up with The Plastics, the school's most popular and most ruthless clique led by queen bee Regina George. As Cady tries to fit in, she learns that popularity comes with a price, and revenge can get ugly fast. Seats are on the main floor. Lunch includes hot entree, potato or rice, vegetable, rolls, dessert and beverage. Price includes transportation, lunch and theatre ticket. (bn)

name: Meditation for Youth

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: This program is much more than just a basic class on calming the body and mind. Participants will learn the tools needed for managing a multitude of concerns including stress, anxiety, emotions, family togetherness, and more. As they progress from youth and adolescence, participants will benefit from understanding the importance of mindfulness and coping skills. Jitendra Desai employs the right method for teaching and helping students tap into the proper ways of handling difficult situations that arise. (km)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6m but less than 6 yrs

description: Make music with your little one! Join local music school, Edge Music Academy, for an early childhood music class led by a licensed, board-certified music therapist. This is a sing-along experience with percussion instruments and other fun accessories, perfect for young children to explore music in an intimate, hands-on setting. A parent or caregiver must be present for all class times due to the young age of students. (sl)

name: Modern/Contemporary: Adult Beginner

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Learn the fundamentals of modern/contemporary dance while strengthening and toning your body and increasing your flexibility. This program is perfect for students new to the modern/contemporary style of dance or those looking to return to the art. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Music for Little Mozarts

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: This class is designed to give your child an exciting introduction to more formal piano instruction. Students will learn musical concepts as they relate to the keyboard while developing their singing, movement, and listening skills simultaneously with an introduction to musical styles. A required lesson book and workbook are available from the instructor at the first class for $12. (sl)

name: Musical Theater Dance

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: Do you dream of being on Broadway someday? Students will focus on learning Broadway-style choreography that combines elements of jazz and ballet. Students will work on storytelling, character development and performance skills. It is perfect for someone new to musical theater and dance or a seasoned performer looking enhance their skills. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Musical Theater Dance: Level 3/4

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 19 yrs

Each class focuses on dance technique, acting, singing skills and team building. It is perfect for the seasoned performer or those who want to enhance their skills. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Musical Theatre Featuring Descendants

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Discover all the “Ways to Be Wicked” in this class that explores the music and themes from Disney’s popular Descendants trilogy! Through drama games, improv, music, and movement, students will learn about the theatre, create cohesive scripts, develop their own villainous characters, and collaborate to construct an original play incorporating themes of love, second chances, family, and self-worth. The session culminates in a one-of-a-kind performance to share with family and friends.(sl)

Every music session is filled with new songs, activities and many wonderful instruments. (sl)

name: Naperville Indoor Soccer- Fall League

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: +Participants enjoy playing in a fun, recreational atmosphere. Games are played at Naperville Yard Sports Complex on Saturdays between 8:00 am and 4:30 pm. Games are played on reduced-sized fields to aid in player development, and standings are not kept. Players are required to wear the NYS jersey which is available to purchase for an additional fee at the Fort Hill Activity Center. Adult volunteer coaches are needed for each team. Register as a full team or as an individual. All grades will play 5v5 and may have a maximum of 10 players on the roster. Grades PreK/K will have a 45-minute practice on the first Saturday of each session instead of a game. Teams will be allocated half of the field to meet their teammates and get accustomed to the synthetic turf. Practice time will be indicated on the game schedule. Grades 1-6 will be game only with games starting the first Saturday. There is an additional $20 fee for each nonresident player for team registrations. The last day to withdraw and receive a refund or register is October 23. Game schedules will be released by November 7. Please note that due to the size and scheduling complexities of the Naperville Indoor Soccer and Naperville Youth Basketball programs, games are likely to conflict. Therefore, we recommend participants register for only one of these programs. (sa)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: The Naperville Premier Soccer League University is an opportunity for 1st grade teams to receive specialized training, while still cultivating a recreational experience. Teams receive one training session per week with a certified soccer trainer, and have games with their volunteer coach on Saturdays. This is a recreational program, no scores or standings are kept. Games are played against NYS teams and must follow the NYS policies such as no running-up of scores. Referees will not be utilized; teams will use parent volunteers and coaches as referees and linesmen. Players must wear the NYS reversible jersey. Non-residents are charged an additional $20 per player which is collected during the roster process. A $200 non-refundable deposit with auto-draw payment plan set-up or full payment is due at the time of registration. The last day to register or withdraw and receive a refund minus the $200 deposit is June 16. There are 7 games in the season and 9 weeks of training. Practices begin the week of August 25 and the first game is September 12. For additional information, please contact Susan Wasson at swasson@napervilleparks.org or www.napervilleparks.org/napervillepremiersoccerleague. (sa)

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: The Naperville Premier Soccer League is designed for teams seeking a program with an enhanced focused on player development and increased competition – still within a recreational environment. Optional technical and tactical training is provided weekly by a certified soccer trainer. Practice time and location is determined by the team and is based on trainer availability. There are 7 games in the season that take place on Saturdays at various parks in Naperville. Non-residents are charged an additional $20 per player which is collected during the roster process. The last day to register for a trainer option is June 16. The last day to register for the league-only option is June 30. A $200 non-refundable deposit with auto-draw payment plan set-up or full payment is due at the time of registration. Teams registering for a “trainer option” have until June 16 to withdraw and receive a refund, minus the $200 deposit. After June 16, the training portion of the fee is non-refundable. Teams registering for “league-only” option have until June 30 to withdraw and receive a refund, minus the $200 deposit. After June 30 all fees are non-refundable. Practices start the week of August 25 with the first game scheduled for September 12. Teams are required to review the complete league details at www.napervilleparks.org/napervillepremiersoccerleague prior to registering. (sa)

name: Naperville Youth NFL FLAG Football

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 12 yrs

description: The Naperville Park District has partnered with the National Football League to offer this flag football league where players learn the game of football in a safe setting. Program emphasizes positive coaching and provides an environment where every child has the opportunity to succeed. Teams typically practice two nights weekly prior to the start of the game schedule and one night weekly once games begin. Practices take place between the hours of 4:00-7:00 p.m. for approximately 60-75 minutes. Participants play a seven-game schedule on Friday nights or Sunday afternoons beginning September 11. All games are played in Naperville at Commissioners Park, Nike Sports Complex, Knoch Park or Prairie Park. Volunteer parent coaches are needed . Players are contacted by their coach with the time of their practice during the week before the first practice. Each player receives an NFL team reversible jersey and an official NFL FLAG belt. Players must provide their own mouthguard. (ba)

name: Naperville Youth Soccer: Boys 1st Grade

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 8y 3m

description: Naperville Youth Soccer is a recreational program that emphasizes fun and learning. Participants will be a part of a team, learn new skills, socialize, be active and have fun! Weekly practice locations are listed below. Teams will practice between the hours of 4:30 and 7:00 p.m. for approximately one hour. Players will be contacted by their coaches one week prior to the start of the season with practice time, game schedule and other important season information. Games are played on Saturdays at various parks throughout Naperville. Game schedules are posted approximately one week prior to the start of the season at https://www.quickscores.com/napervilleparks. The Pre-K and K programs are age based; grade level not applicable. Pre-K participants must be 4 years old as of 9/1/2026. Kindergarten participants must be 5-6 years 3 months old as of 9/1/2026 and not in 1st grade. All other participants must register for the grade they are in during the fall season. Please register or waitlist for one team only. Anyone registered on a team AND on a waitlist will be removed from the waitlist without notice. Adult volunteer coaches are required for each team. Coaching preference is selected at time of registration. Coaches are assigned by order of registration. Coaches that are selected will receive their coaching information and assignments by mid August. Pre-K - 1st grade teams use parent volunteers and coaches as game referees and linesmen. The first practice is the week of August 24. There are 7 games with the first game scheduled for September 12. Participants must wear a NYS reversible jersey which is purchased separately and available for sale at the Fort Hill Activity Center. For complete league information, including uniform requirements, please visit https://www.napervilleparks.org/napervilleyouthsoccer. (sa)

name: Nature Discovery Kits

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Discover nature at home with one of our themed Nature Discovery Kits! Kits include: Information/instruction sheets, coloring pages and/or scavengers hunts, supplies for crafts and materials/instructions for a game or two. Most kits are designed for a family of up to 4 children; other kits are for one child only. Please see each kit description for specific details on kit themes and availability.

name: Nature Playtime

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 4 yrs

description: Playing is how children learn! Research shows how important spending time outside is for a child's physical, social and mental development. Join a naturalist for a fall multi-week session. Each themed, but unstructured, nature playtime takes place completely outdoors rain or shine so dress for the weather. Please note: Your child may get wet and dirty - it's part of the fun! Caregivers stay with their child. (ah)

name: New Horizons Band DuPage

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: New Horizons Band DuPage provides musical instrument instruction and music-making for active adults and seniors, including those with no previous musical experience and those who have been musically inactive. Learn how to read music and play a musical instrument, or jump right in and participate in a concert band (musical instrument experience required). Every person has musical potential that can be developed to a level that will be personally rewarding. Individuals are encouraged to practice on their own outside of class and may be invited to perform in concerts at the end of each season. Each participant must own, purchase, rent or borrow the band instrument that they choose to play. New Horizons Band DuPage has some instruments that can be rented or can suggest locations where instruments can be rented or purchased. Music method books are required for the beginner and intermediate classes. Payment of $13 will be collected at the first class (price subject to change). Please make checks payable to New Horizons Band. Visit www.nhbdupage.org for more information. It's never too late to toot your own horn! (bn)

name: NPSL Fall 2026 Waivers

age_range.raw_age_text: All ages

description: These are waiver codes only for those who have already completed a TEAM registration. Participants must have permission from the coach of the team to register. Those without permission will be withdrawn. There is a $20 fee for non-residents. University (1st Grade): All players must be in 1st grade in order to be roster eligible. Players who are in an older grade may not participate on the team even if their age fits within the parameters set in the system for registration purposes. 2nd Grade: All players must be in 2nd grade in order to be roster eligible. Players who are in an older grade may not participate on the team even if their age fits within the parameters set in the system for registration purposes. 3rd-8th Grade: All players must be in the grade or a grade below which the team has registered for in order to be roster eligible. Players who are in an older grade may not participate on the team even if their age fits within the parameters set in the system for registration purposes.

name: NYS Academy: Threes

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 4 yrs

description: The NYS Academy program is a great opportunity for younger children to become part of our Naperville Youth Soccer tradition. This coed, practice-only program introduces basic soccer skills in a fun, active and social environment. Teams meet once a week for approximately 30 - 45 minutes. Weekly practice locations and times are listed below. Please register according to your player’s age as of 9/1/2026. Please register or waitlist for one team only. Anyone registered on a team AND on a waitlist will be removed from the waitlist without notice. Adult volunteer coaches are required for each team. Coaching preference is selected at time of registration. Coaches will be contacted and provided with age-appropriate lesson plans by August 14. Players will be contacted by their coach the week of August 16. For more information, please visit https://napervilleparks.org/napervilleyouthsocceracademy. (sa)

name: One-Stroke Painting for Beginners

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Build your painting skills by learning and applying techniques made famous by Donna Dewberry. Through practice, become proficient in proper brush loading, which is the key to one-stroke painting success! Then, test your artistry to create a variety of leaves and flowers with shading and highlighting effects using just one stroke of the brush. You'll want to paint everything you can get your hands on! All supplies are available for a fee of $25 payable to instructor at the first class. (bd)

name: Open Table Tennis

age_range.raw_age_text: 11 yrs +

description: This is an opportunity for table tennis players to come and enjoy open gym. There are 8+ tables total and play is rotated throughout the night. (sa)

name: Paddlewheel Riverboat & Durant-Peterson House

age_range.raw_age_text: 21 yrs +

description: St. Charles, IL Start with a 1.5-hour private charter paddlewheel boat ride down a quiet and peaceful section of the Fox River. Learn about the history of the St. Charles area. Lunch on board will be served on the lower deck. Bagged lunch choices are a ham sub sandwich or turkey sub sandwich with chips, cookies and a drink. If you have dietary restrictions, please choose the applicable option during registration. Although there are nice views from the lower level and bow, head to the upper deck after lunch (12-15 steps) for a more expansive view. Visit the 1843 Durant-Peterson House museum. Docents dressed in period clothing will bring the group back in time to experience what life was like living on the Illinois Prairie in the late 1800s. Partake in an heirloom apple sampling. Learn the history of apples around the world and how apples became a vital part of pioneer life. There will be a variety of heirloom apples to taste and compare. Price includes transportation, lunch, boat ride, museum entrance with guide and apple tasting. (bn)

name: Parent Tot Playtime

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Experience the fun of the Fort Hill Activity Center's gymnastics room for one hour of unstructured gym time. Designed for children ages 2 through 5. Must be accompanied and assisted by a guardian. Pre-registration required with registration closing one hour before the start of each session. (dn)

name: Parent/Child Dino Hour in the Park

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: Bring your little one for an hour of dinosaur discovery fun! They'll see and touch real dinosaur fossils, listen to a story, make a craft to take home and dig in the sand to assemble dinosaur puzzle pieces. This is a parent/child activity. Register child only; parent attends for free. (bd)

name: Parent/Child Holiday Ornaments

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: In this class create beautiful ornaments that you’ll enjoy hanging on your holiday tree year after year. Register with friends and family to have a festive holiday experience. Join us in making this fun and easy craft. Instructor will provide everything needed. A $10 supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Parent/Child Introduction to Sewing

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 19 yrs

description: Join us for an introductory sewing class, no experience needed! Participants will learn how to thread a machine, wind a bobbin, and sew a fun project. Sewing machines will be provided for use in class. If you have your own working sewing machine, you are welcome to bring it. All supplies needed will be provided by the instructor. Class is open to ages 7-18. Parents need to attend class with children ages 7-11. Adults who are assisting children do not need a separate registration as they will be working on a single project together. A supply fee is payable to instructor at first class. (bd)

name: Parent/Child: Holiday Memories Gift Boutique

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Join Glitzy Girlz for our most treasured holiday gift class. Each couple will team up to make special hand-made gifts for family & friends. You will make and take home three personalized gifts consisting of crafts and a jewelry piece. The gifts can be made for girls and boys of all ages using a wide variety of beads and trinkets. Each pair will have supplies to make gift bags, tags and tissue to conceal the holiday surprises! Parents must accompany their child and participate in class. (bd)

name: Parking Permits

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 15 yrs but less than 20 yrs

description: The Naperville Park District offers parking spaces for Neuqua Valley and Naperville Central High School students. Permit holders will be eligible for parking in the designated spaces at the Skate Park lot at Frontier, the gravel lot off of West Street or the designated spaces at the Centennial Beach parking lot. Permits purchased online will be mailed to the address listed on your account within two weeks of purchase. If you purchase online, your receipt will act as your confirmation of purchase until your receive your permit. Please print your receipt and place it on your dashboard until your permit arrives. Permits also may be purchased in person at the Alfred Rubin Riverwalk Community Center, the Knoch Knolls Nature Center or the Fort Hill Activity Center. Applications must be signed by a parent or guardian. Spaces are not assigned and are available first come, first served ONLINE REGISTRATION OPENS JULY 11, 2026. WALK IN WILL BE AVAILABLE JULY 11, 2026. CHECK WEBSITE FOR FACILITY HOURS. If you are participating in your school lottery for a permit, please wait for those results before purchasing an NPD parking permit.

name: Pickleball

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Pickleball is a fast-growing racket sport that is best described as a mix of badminton, tennis and ping-pong that can be played by nearly everyone. Program consists of instruction followed by actual game play. Players should wear athletic shoes and dress as for tennis. Equipment is provided, but bring your own pickleball paddle if you have one. (ba)

name: Pickleball: Practice with the Pro Private Instruction

age_range.raw_age_text: 4 yrs +

description: Our pickleball pros are available for private or semi-private lessons scheduled at a mutually-convenient time. Two levels of lessons are available and may be scheduled with one to three persons in a group. Instruction with one of our teaching pros is available at a cost of $69 per hour. Lessons with one of our Certified Pros are $79 per hour. Purchase a five-lesson package and save. To schedule a private lesson, register for the lesson and a staff member will be in touch with you to schedule the day and time. Lesson cancelations must be done 24 hours in advance in order to receive a credit. (ba)

name: Pirouette with Me

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1y 6m but less than 4 yrs

description: Explore ballet with your little one in this special program that includes props, stories, music and more! It focuses on engaging little ones with familiar music in a high-energy environment introducing ballet technique while building coordination skills, memory and listening skills. Adult is free and must accompany child; maximum two children per adult. Please register each child separately. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. name: Seminar: How Taxes Impact Retirement Income

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: If you are nearing retirement or already retired, you need to understand how taxes impact your retirement income, as it may be possible to pay less in taxes on your hard-earned dollars. Learn the most up-to-date and comprehensive information regarding retirement taxation, including ways to efficiently harvest income sources, whether they are Social Security, 401K/IRA, other sources or a combination of them all. Presentation provided by Greg Kurinec. Although this program is free, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Legacy Planning for Your Final Transition

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: Planning for the final transition, whether for yourself or for someone you love, is a deeply personal and often emotional process. Thoughtful planning is one of the most meaningful gifts you can give yourself and those you care about. It provides direction, reduces uncertainty, and creates a sense of comfort during life’s most challenging moments. It involves more than organizing documents. It’s about honoring wishes, preserving dignity, and easing the responsibilities that fall on family during an already difficult time. Join this seminar to learn about beginning the conversation early, exploring planning tools such as secure digital vaults, and seeking support when you need it. Whether you are preparing in advance or navigating arrangements after a loss, resources are available to help you feel informed and supported. While this is a free event, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Mobility and Accessibility Solutions

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: Discover practical solutions that can help you stay safe, comfortable and independent in your own home. Join us to learn about a variety of accessibility and mobility equipment designed to make everyday activities easier and support aging in place with confidence. Whether you're planning ahead or looking for immediate solutions, this presentation will provide valuable information for you and your loved ones. A boxed lunch will be provided. While this is a free event, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Protecting Your Savings from Long-Term Care Costs

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: A nursing home in Illinois can cost more than $100,000 a year. For many families, that bill quietly drains a lifetime of savings and puts the family home at risk. The good news is that you have more options than most people think, and the best ones are available years before you ever need care. Estate planning attorney Brandon Ayers will walk you through how Illinois families protect what they have built. You will learn how a Medicaid Asset Protection Trust works, why the five-year look-back matters, and what can still be done when a parent or spouse needs care right now. We will keep it plain. No legal jargon, just clear answers to the questions families actually ask. Although this is a free presentation, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Spotting Charity Scams

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: In this season of giving, make sure your generosity reaches the people and causes you care about most. Scammers often pose as legitimate charities, making it increasingly difficult to tell the difference between a genuine request for help and a fraudulent one. Join us to learn how to identify common warning signs of charitable scams and gain a better understanding of the difference between tax-deductible and tax-exempt organizations so you can give with confidence. This presentation is provided by Naperville Bank & Trust. Space is limited. While this program is free, registration is required. (bn)

name: Seminar: Your Guide to Travel Independence with RTA

age_range.raw_age_text: 40 yrs +

description: Want to learn how older adults and people with disabilities can save money on public transportation? Want to learn how to make sure your trip on public transit is accessible? Come join the Regional Transportation Authority (RTA) as we talk about accessible public transportation options and traveling independently. Although this presentation is free, registration is required. (bn)

name: Senior Kung Fu

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

age_range.raw_age_text: 15 yrs +

name: SHIP-December

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: SHIP is the Illinois State Health Insurance Assistance Program. Whether you are new to Medicare or already enrolled, SHIP is a great way to get information and answers about health insurance coverage for seniors. If you are considering a prescription drug plan, please bring your Medicare card, any other insurance cards and a list of your medications, including dosage and frequency to your appointment. If you would like to see if you might be eligible for financial help in paying for Medicare, bring your most recent tax return. Open Enrollment occurs every year between October 15 and December 7. Appointments during this time frame are for those who would like to review their Medicare Part C coverage or Part D prescription plans to insure you have the most comprehensive, cost efficient coverage for the upcoming year. Information on health insurance coverage for seniors includes the following: Medicare A & B (hospital/doctor), Medicare C (Medicare Advantage Plans/HMO, PPO, PFFS), Medicare D (Prescription Drug Plans), Medicare Supplemental Policies (Medigap), Long Term Care Insurance and Medicaid Programs. Counselors are trained and sponsored by the State of Illinois Department on Aging. Appointments are available between 9:00 a.m. and 11:00 a.m. To register, call 630-848-5000 or go online to napervilleparks.org to book an appointment with a SHIP counselor. (bn)

name: Swim Conditioning: Youth

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 17 yrs

description: Conditioning and stroke clinic is open to any swimmer in second grade through high school. Swimmers must be able to swim competitively. Swimmers should already know how to swim a 50-yard freestyle and 50-yard backstroke. Stroke clinics improve swimmer skills in each of the four strokes along with starts and turns. (cj)

name: Swim Lessons: Flexible Private Swim Lessons

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This program is designed to improve each child's swimming skills at his or her own pace. Lessons provide students with personally differentiated instruction from exceptional teachers and provide an excellent opportunity to give your child a head start in swimming or see rapid improvement in technique and skill level. Lessons are scheduled at your convivence. You will be contacted to schedule your lessons. If a session needs to be canceled there is a 24 hour notice policy. Each package includes 4 lessons. Lesson times available are 9:30-10:00, 10:05-10:35, 10:40-11:10 and 11:15-11:45. (cj)

name: Swim Lessons: Indoor

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This program is designed to improve each child's swimming skills at his or her own pace. Swimmers are placed by skill level and each participant will learn water safety skills appropriate to their level. Level 1 class size is 2-4 students; Levels 2-7 class size is 3-5 students. Swimming requires advanced motor coordination that takes practice; it is normal for a swimmer to remain at the same level for more than one session. If, after a session begins, we believe a swimmer has been placed in an inappropriate level, we will make the adjustment to ensure that every child will feel comfortable at their assigned level. (cj)

name: Swim Lessons: Private Swim Lessons

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: This program is designed to improve each child's swimming skills at his or her own pace. Lessons provide students with personally differentiated instruction from exceptional teachers and provide an excellent opportunity to give your child a head start in swimming or see rapid improvement in technique and skill level. Lessons are scheduled at your convenience. You will be contacted prior to the session start date to schedule these lessons. (jg)

name: Tai Chi: Adult & Senior-Practice and Instructional

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Looking for better balance, gentle movement, stress relief and moving meditation? Tai Chi might be just what you are looking for and it will complement your other exercise routines. The many benefits of Tai Chi including maintaining mobility, agility, health and vitality can be found in these simple movements. See why Tai Chi has been practiced for centuries to benefit the mind and body. Practice vs Instructional Classes: Practice classes have minimal instruction allowing the student to just follow along in the various exercises and movements to focus on relaxing and breathing. Every level Practice class has a corresponding level Instructional class. Instructional classes provide detailed explanation of everything contained in the Practice class. Ideally, a student would take both. Adult vs Senior Classes: Adult and Senior Tai Chi classes have the same content and instruction. Senior classes are priced for those 50 and over. Anyone 60 and over can register for an Adult Tai Chi class and receive a 20% senior discount. In Person vs Virtual vs Hybrid: Some classes are in person only; some are virtual only (via Zoom) and some are hybrid. Hybrid classes are simultaneously offered in person and via Zoom. If you cannot attend an in-person class on a specific date, you can participate at home via Zoom. (jg)

name: Tai Chi: Adult Advanced Two Person Energy Work

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Adult Advanced Two Person Energy Work is for the advanced student and participation in this class requires the permission of Master Troy. This class is for students already taking Advanced Tai Chi classes and are interested in developing their Tai Chi energy by working with other students and learning an advanced Tai Chi Form. Classes meet on designated Saturdays. The add-on option is for students also registered for two other classes with Master Troy. All others use the stand-alone option. (bn)

name: Tap/Jazz

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 10 yrs

description: This program is designed to build a solid dance foundation. Dancers learn proper posture and technique while being introduced to dance terminology from both dance styles. The program focuses on the fundamentals of jazz technique, while incorporating tap to help with rhythm, tempo and distribution of weight. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Tap/Jazz Basics

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: This program is designed to build a solid dance foundation. Dancers learn proper posture and technique while being introduced to dance terminology from both dance styles. The program focuses on the fundamentals of jazz technique, while incorporating tap to help with rhythm, tempo and distribution of weight. Please visit our website at www.napervilleparks.org/dance for dress code information. (sl)

name: Technology Training for Seniors

age_range.raw_age_text: 50 yrs +

description: With new technology evolving daily, learning how to use it for everyday applications can be intimidating. Technology help sessions are offered in person or virtually to help seniors overcome fears and get their technology questions answered. The program is instructed by informed and helpful student volunteers from the Neuqua Valley High School Interact Service Club who work with you at your own pace. Each class will center around your specific tech-related needs that can include browsing the internet, using Google services, operating Apple or Android smartphones/devices, using Microsoft applications such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint or any number of other tech skills. Some participants may need only a single session, while others may need more. After participating in an in-person session you can set up one-hour virtual sessions offered on a flexible schedule (times to be worked out between the participant and the student volunteers). Make sure your phone number and email address on file are updated, so our students do not have any issues contacting you. This free program meets in D210 at Neuqua Valley High School. Park in the main lot (teacher lot) off Skylane Drive at 95th St. Turn into the front drive, take the first left and left again into the parking lot. Accessible parking is closer to doors 3 and 7. Enter by the auditorium at Door 7, or Door 3, which is our main entrance during construction. Students should be there to help guide you to the room. There is an elevator. Email gillian_schneider@ipsd.org with questions. (bn)

name: Tennis: Adult Cardio Tennis

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Have fun playing tennis while improving your fitness level! Get a great workout in your target heart-rate zone while working through tennis and fitness drills. Led by our certified instructors, Cardio Tennis is designed for Advanced Beginner/Low Intermediate players and above. Players should bring their own racquets, an ample supply of water and wear stable athletic shoes. Players who sign up at an inappropriate level will be removed from the class and offered a skill matched class. One makeup class will be offered in the event of inclement weather. (ba)

name: Tennis: Adult Drill & Play

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Drill & Play classes use situational, competitive point play with players of like ability in order to challenge participants and test their skills in a fun drill setting that incorporates coaching during match play. 2.0-2.4 Beginners are not an appropriate fit for these classes as there is less focus on skill acquisition and more focus on competitive play. This clinic format focuses on singles and doubles strategies, shot consistency, specialty shots, developing a variety of serves and returns with intent to construct points that use high percentage tactics. Players should bring their own racquets, an ample supply of water and wear stable athletic shoes. Players who sign up at an inappropriate level will be removed from the class and offered a skill matched Drill & Play. If you wish to sign up for the Tu/Th 8:00 p.m. class please email mpollack@napervilleparks.org. Any classes canceled due to weather will be made up. (ba)

name: Tennis: LEARN: Adult Instructional Clinics

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Improve your game and have fun testing your skills against other players at your level. Join the adult instructional clinics to learn and improve your tennis skills. Players should self-rate using the following NTRP rating scale: 2.0-2.4 Beginner - have never played or have very limited tennis experience. Emphasis is on the introduction of forehand, backhand, serve, volley, scoring rules. 2.5-2.9 Adv Beginner/Low Intermediate - these players have knowledge of scoring and rules and may have had some lessons, they can keep a ball in play with others of similar ability. Emphasis is on improving all strokes, increasing consistency and accuracy, while providing more challenging drills. 3.0-3.4 High Intermediate - more experienced players can place shots with accuracy and are highly consistent at being able to sustain rallies and have strong footwork allowing for court coverage. Emphasis is on competitive, shots in tough movement situations, improving and enhancing serves and returns using a variety of spin, and coaching high percentage doubles and singles strategies. Players need to bring racquets, water and wear athletic shoes. If classes are canceled due to weather, make ups will be provided on the same schedule, consecutive days following the conclusion of the regular session. Players enrolled at the incorrect level will be moved to an appropriate level class. (ba)

name: Tennis: Little Aces

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 8 yrs

description: Introduce your kids to a lifetime of tennis fun. We focus on the ABCs - agility, balance and coordination - using a variety of games, contests and other fun activities. Children learn basic tennis skills utilizing the USTA's 10-and-under tennis pathway on smaller courts using special racquets and red tennis balls. Children must wear tennis shoes; and bring own racquets. If classes are canceled due to weather, one makeup will be scheduled. (ba)

name: Tennis: Little Aces Indoor

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 7 yrs

description: Introduce your kids to a lifetime of tennis fun. Program focuses on the ABCs - agility, balance and coordination - using a variety of games, contests and other fun activities. This program provides a great introduction to the sport of tennis using special mini nets, smaller racquets, and red tennis balls. A tennis racquet is needed. A limited supply of racquets are available. Children should wear tennis shoes. (ba)

name: Tennis: Parent/Child Learn and Play

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 9 yrs

description: This program is designed to introduce your child to a lifetime of tennis fun! During the first part of the lesson, parents assist their child using the ABCs - agility, balance and coordination - using fun, tennis-based activities. Children learn basic tennis skills utilizing the USTA's 10-and-under tennis pathway on smaller courts using special racquets and red tennis balls. The second part of the lesson is dedicated to play; first with the child playing with the parent and later playing against other children with the parents as coaches. Children use our special mini racquets; regulation racquets are needed for parents. Fee is per couple; one parent per child registered. In case of rain, up to two makeups are scheduled. (ba)

name: Tennis: Practice with the Pro Private Instruction

age_range.raw_age_text: 4 yrs +

description: Our tennis pros are available for private or semi-private lessons scheduled at a mutually-convenient time. Two levels of lessons are available and may be scheduled with one to three persons in a group. Instruction with one of our teaching pros is available at a cost of $69 per hour. Lessons with one of our USPTA/USPTR Certified Pros are $79 per hour. Purchase a five-lesson package and save 10%. Purchase a ten-lesson package and save 15%. To schedule a private lesson, register for the lesson and a staff member will be in touch with you to schedule the day and time. (ba)

name: Tennis: Rally Partner

age_range.raw_age_text: 4 yrs +

description: Improve your hitting consistency when you rally with one of our high school/college staff. Session does not include instruction, just plenty of fun hitting many, many tennis balls for a solid hour. Purchase a five-lesson package and save 10%. Register for the program and a staff member will be in touch with you to schedule the day and time. (ba)

name: Tennis: Youth Outdoor

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 18 yrs

description: Players learn to play or improve their tennis game with our experienced staff. Players should wear closed toe gym shoes, comfortable clothing, and provide an appropriate sized racket and water bottle. Players are grouped by ability. If classes are canceled due to weather, one makeup will be scheduled the week following the end of the session. Orange Ball classes utilize the ABCs - agility, balance and coordination - along with instruction on basic tennis strokes using a 60' tennis court and special orange tennis balls. Green Ball program is designed for youth players ages 8-11 who have progressed their skills in Orange Ball (ages 7-10). Green Ball utilizes a slightly decompressed ball on a full-sized court. Green Ball players have developed foundational skills in the red and/or orange ball levels and can now learn to integrate a faster ball played on the standard singles and doubles courts. Yellow Ball classes use a standard tennis ball . Beginners have never played tennis or have played a limited amount, but not on a regular basis. Class emphasizes introduction of forehand, backhand, serve, shot placement, positioning, scoring and rules. Advanced Beginners have knowledge of scoring and rules and may have had some lessons, but lack on-court experience. They can keep a ball in play with others of similar ability. Class emphasizes improvement of basic strokes and works on positioning, shot placement, footwork and serve consistency. Intermediates are those who can place shots with moderate success and sustain a rally at a slow pace. They are still learning all strokes and lack consistency in serving. (ba)

name: The Buddy Holly Story

age_range.raw_age_text: 21 yrs +

description: Drury Lane Theatre, Oakbrook Terrace Discover the life and music of rock and roll pioneer Buddy Holly from his early start in Texas to his meteoric rise to fame and untimely death at the age of 22. Experience the original sound that changed rock and roll music as we know it. Lunch choices are Roasted Salmon or Three 2 oz Petite Filets. If needed, please request a vegetarian, gluten-free or vegan option. Price includes transportation, lunch and theatre ticket. (bn)

name: Tinkering Lab

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 4 yrs but less than 6 yrs

description: The Tinkering Lab is a hands-on learning space where preschoolers explore, create, build, and problem-solve using a variety of materials and tools. Children are encouraged to experiment, ask questions, test ideas, and discover how things work through open-ended play. Through collaboration with peers, they share ideas, work together on projects, practice communication skills, and learn from one another's perspectives. Activities may include building structures, designing simple inventions, exploring cause and effect, and engaging in cooperative challenges. The Tinkering Lab fosters creativity, critical thinking, teamwork, perseverance, and confidence while nurturing a love of exploration and innovation. Participants must be toilet-trained and be able to separate from parent/caregiver. No class Nov. 27. (sc)

name: Tot Rock

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 1 yr but less than 2y 6m

description: Sing, dance, play, learn, and imagine with us! This movement-based program uses music to facilitate learning. Students will use rhythm instruments and movement props, work on gross and fine motor skills, including balance and coordination, and engage in imaginative play. All classes are structured and include early listening and following directions skills. Join us for a rockin’ good time! (sl)

name: Trapshooting Fundamentals

age_range.raw_age_text: 13 yrs +

description: Learn trapshooting range etiquette and proper gun handling techniques from Naperville Sportsman's Club instructors. Then, shoot a round of trap under the supervision of an instructor. Fee includes ammunition, clay targets, use of a shotgun and eye/ear protective gear. Those ages 13-17 must register and attend with an adult. (dn)

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Volleyball court rental is for 60 minutes, renter must check-in at the Fort Hill Customer Service Desk. Maximum participants for the rental is 14, no rotating courts, you may only play on your reserved court with your group. No bystanders allowed. Please exit the gymnasium immediately once your hour time slot has finished. Arrive only 5 minutes prior to reservation time. You must bring your own volleyball. Rentals may only be made up to 7 days in advance. (km)

name: Volleyball: CoRec Adult Leagues

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Calling all volleyball enthusiasts! Coed volleyball leagues are offered at A, B, C and Rec levels. Placement of teams within a division is at the discretion of the park district. Leagues take place at the Fort Hill Activity Center, featuring wood floors and high ceilings! Individuals may register for the individual team. Dates listed are tentative. Captains will be contacted with schedules. All fees are per team plus $20 per nonresident player. (ba)

name: Volleyball: CoRec Adult Leagues C Division Individual FEMALE

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Calling all volleyball enthusiasts! Coed volleyball leagues are offered at A, B, C and Rec levels. Placement of teams within a division is at the discretion of the park district. Leagues take place at the Fort Hill Activity Center, featuring wood floors and high ceilings! (ba)

name: Volleyball: CoRec Adult Leagues C Division Individual MALE

age_range.raw_age_text: 18 yrs +

description: Calling all volleyball enthusiasts! Coed volleyball leagues are offered at A, B, C and Rec levels. Placement of teams within a division is at the discretion of the park district. Leagues take place at the Fort Hill Activity Center, featuring wood floors, new equipment and high ceilings! (ba)

name: Volleyball: EVP Junior Volleykidz USA

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 11 yrs

description: Volleykidz is an introductory class that introduces the pass, set and spike using a very light volleyball. Volleykidz will improve each child's hand/eye coordination and left/right coordination through the use of fun drills and games. Instruction also incorporates short educational drills including spelling, math and science. (ba)

name: Volleyball: EVP Volley Series Match Play

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: Interested in playing volleyball matches with other volleyball training to compete in grade school and highschool? Our volleyball pro will develop a team with weekly instruction to prepare for games against other athletes. The coaches' lesson plan will guide the team in weekly training for 90 minutes. At weekly practice the teams will play matches and learn team defense and offense positions while they improve on their fundamentals of passing, setting, spiking, and overhand serving. This is a 4-week program that meets once per week for 90 minutes. Each athlete receives a Volley Series t-shirt at the 1st event. (ba)

name: Volleyball: EVP Volleykidz USA

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 10 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Improve your volleyball skills with drills in setting, passing, overhand serving and spiking. The lesson plan directs the use of individual training, pairing drills and game situation development that help each student reach a new level. Instructors organize short games at the end of each class. The lesson plan also incorporates leadership and educational components. (ba)

name: Volleyball: Youth Volleyball League

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 15 yrs

description: The Naperville Park District has partnered with Hudson Sportsplex to offer this youth volleyball league where players learn the game of volleyball in a recreational setting. Program emphasizes positive coaching and provides an environment where every child has the opportunity to succeed. Instruction will be provided by Head Coach of the Yorkville Christian High School, Jake Elder, for the first 40 minutes and league match play will take place the final 35 minutes each week. The league incorporates 8 weeks of instruction and match play. Volunteer parent coaches are needed . (ba)

name: Water Color Pencil Art

age_range.raw_age_text: Age at least 9 yrs but less than 13 yrs

description: Embark on an enchanting adventure into the forest with watercolor pencils! After sketching plant and animal drafts with artist pencils onto paper, the kids will then be using soft quality watercolor pencils and small paintbrushes to bring their creations to life. They will apply different watercolor techniques to create fairy tale forest scenes. This class is perfect for experienced students seeking to expand their creativity, or beginners eager to try something new. All the necessary artist supplies are included in this small-group workshop. (bd)
